workItem: Repair LF-02 post-Google-login convergence so returning MFA-enabled accounts enter the native AAL2 gate before profile hydration and the landing session is published only after server-authoritative subscription readback.
workItemDE: LF-02: AAL2 direkt nach Google-Login und autoritativen Enterprise-Abo-Readback herstellen
projectStage: cross-cutting presentation/auth composition; no productive PVC
priorityReason: Productive Google login currently delays mandatory AAL2 presentation and can expose a provisional Free tier for an owner/Enterprise account.
scopeBoundary: Supabase Auth remains the sole primary authentication and MFA authority.
The existing /api/stripe/user-subscription endpoint remains the sole browser-visible subscription authority.
No email-based owner/Enterprise bypass is introduced; identity remains bound to the verified Supabase user UUID.
Returning accounts with nextLevel=aal2 may render the step-up gate before the onboarding profile roundtrip, but onboarding is rechecked after MFA before session publication.
No Supabase schema/data mutation, Stripe mutation, Render mutation, deployment, or Human/CODEOWNER merge is performed.

evidence.supabaseReadback: Target account has iam_role=owner, profile role=enterprise, active Enterprise subscription, onboarding_required=false, and one verified TOTP factor.
evidence.codeFinding: SessionComposition published subscriptionTier=Free before asynchronous authoritative readback and awaited needsOnboarding before rendering LoginStepUpGate.
evidence.openWriterOverlap: No open PR matched SessionComposition/LoginStepUpGate/subscription-readback scope at branch start.

acceptanceCriteria: After Google OAuth, a returning account whose Supabase assurance state is aal1 -> aal2 reaches the AAL2 gate before the onboarding profile Data-API roundtrip.
The TOTP prompt becomes visible as soon as the verified factor is known; challenge creation may finish while the prompt is already rendered.
Onboarding remains fail-closed and is revalidated after successful MFA before the application session is published.
No registered session is published with a provisional Free tier.
The authenticated subscription endpoint must return a canonical tier before userSession is projected; unresolved or invalid readback fails closed.
Owner/Enterprise accounts resolve through the existing server UUID/iam_role/subscription authority and project Enterprise to the landing sideboard.
Focused auth, post-MFA, entitlement and session-composition regression tests pass.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
releaseReason: Merged in PR #1255 and superseded by Owner-directed SEC-AUTH-DIAG-AAL2-01 diagnostic supersession.
